user.title: Select data sources
user.description: Choose entities from your vehicle (including the official Škoda integration), electricity price integration, and charger.

data_description.plugged_entity: If omitted, Zaptec operating mode is used. A generic switch assumes the vehicle is connected; select a connection sensor to detect unplugging.
data_description.price_entity: Supports Nord Pool today/tomorrow and raw price attributes, or a generic numeric price sensor.
data_description.power_entity: Values in W and kW are accepted.

abort.already_configured: This vehicle and charger combination is already configured.

data.norgespris_fill: Allow charging outside preferred hours to reach 100%

data_description.plugged_entity: If omitted, the Zaptec operating mode is used.
data_description.price_entity: Supports Nord Pool today/tomorrow and raw price attributes, or a generic numeric price sensor.
data_description.power_entity: Used to learn the real charging rate; values in W and kW are accepted.
data_description.price_markup: Use the same currency and per-kWh unit as the price entity.
data_description.night_grid_fee: Added during the configured night period.
data_description.fixed_energy_price: Use for a fixed-price scheme; -1 keeps spot pricing.
data_description.support_rate: Fraction above the threshold that is compensated.
data_description.norgespris_mode: Requires a non-negative fixed energy price; uses the configured night tariff hours.
data_description.norgespris_fill: Uses preferred hours first; extends before or after those hours up to the departure deadline if necessary.

confirm.title: Turn smart charging back on?
confirm.description:
Smart charging is switched off while the car is connected, so {name} is not controlling the charger.

- Planned charging will **not** start, so the car may not be ready by departure.
- Charging started by hand (charger app, RFID or authorizing the charger) is **not** stopped, even outside the planned or low-tariff hours.

Select **Submit** to turn smart charging on. The plan then controls the charger again: it starts and stops charging itself, and stops any session started outside the plan. To charge right away regardless of the plan, use the **Charge now** switch instead of authorizing the charger yourself.

If you switched it off on purpose, you can ignore this warning.

abort.not_loaded: The integration is not loaded. Reload it and try again.
